faqs.question: How often should I visit the dentist?
faqs.answer: For most patients, we recommend a check-up and professional cleaning every six months. Regular visits help us detect issues early, before they become painful or expensive to treat.

faqs.question: Do you offer payment plans or installment options?
faqs.answer: Yes! We understand dental treatments can be a significant investment. We offer flexible installment plans for major treatments like implants, braces, and full-mouth rehabilitation. Ask our front desk for details.

faqs.question: What should I do in a dental emergency?
faqs.answer: Call us immediately at +92 312 5028812 or message us on WhatsApp. We keep same-day emergency slots open and provide immediate care for severe toothache, broken teeth, knocked-out teeth, and other urgent dental issues.

blog.title: 10 Everyday Habits That Keep Your Teeth Healthy
blog.excerpt: Simple, science-backed habits that protect your smile between visits — straight from the Junaid Dental Care team.
blog.content:
Great oral health starts at home. Here are ten simple habits our dentists recommend to keep your teeth and gums in top shape between visits.

1. Brush Twice a Day

Use fluoride toothpaste and brush for at least two minutes, morning and night. Replace your toothbrush every 3 months.

2. Floss Daily

Flossing removes plaque from between your teeth where your brush can't reach. Just once a day makes a huge difference.

3. Limit Sugary Snacks

Bacteria in your mouth feed on sugar and produce acid that erodes enamel. Choose fruits, nuts, and cheese for healthier snacks.

4. Drink More Water

Water rinses away food particles and keeps your mouth hydrated. Pakistani cities can be hot — keep a water bottle handy.

5. Don't Skip Your Check-ups

Visit Junaid Dental Care every six months. Early detection saves you pain, time, and money.

For personalised advice, book a consultation with our team. We're here to help you keep a healthy smile for life.

blog.title: Braces vs Clear Aligners: Which Is Right for You?
blog.excerpt: Our orthodontist explains the differences between traditional braces and clear aligners to help you make the right choice.
blog.content:
One of the most common questions we get at Junaid Dental Care is: should I get braces or clear aligners? The answer depends on your case, lifestyle, and budget. Here's an honest comparison.

Traditional Metal Braces

Best for: Complex alignment issues, severe crowding, bite correction, younger patients.
Pros: Most affordable, highly effective, work for all cases.
Cons: Visible, dietary restrictions, more frequent visits.

Clear Aligners (Invisalign-style)

Best for: Mild to moderate alignment, adults who want discretion.
Pros: Nearly invisible, removable for eating, fewer clinic visits.
Cons: Higher cost, requires discipline (22 hrs/day), not for complex cases.

What We Recommend

Book a free orthodontic consultation with Dr. Hassan Raza. He'll examine your teeth, show you a 3D simulation of your potential results, and recommend the option that fits your case and budget.
